content: Tool error: Set KOTA_EVAL_CONTAINED_PROFILES in the trusted host environment. Each named profile declares scopeRoots, preset, fixtureIds, candidates, maxRepeats, timeoutMs, cpuCores, memoryMB, and a container isolationBackend with image and restricted provider-egress networkPolicy. See src/modules/eval-harness/contained-evaluation.md for image and restricted egress setup; worker request bodies cannot configure host access.
